data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2020 the syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding was GBP 456.646m. The syndicate reported an adverse prior-year development (deterioration) of GBP 7.9m (net) to claims reserves established at the prior year end, principally driven by unfavourable developments in Property, Third party liability and Accident & Health; partially offsetting favourable development occurred across other classes. A material RITC transaction (assumption of 2017 years from other syndicates) distorts the gross development triangle, so no reliable gross prior-year movement is reported in the notes; the only explicit quantified prior-year movement is the GBP 7.9m net deterioration reported in the claims note. The 2020 results were also heavily affected by Covid-19 and a severe Atlantic hurricane season (notably Hurricane Laura).
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 473.6m (2019: GBP 302.5m) is a deterioration of GBP 7.9m (2019: deterioration of GBP 8.4m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to unfavourable developments on Property, Third party liability and Accident and Health with partially offsetting favourable developments across the other classes.
Claims in respect of the Covid-19 pandemic total GBP 128m net of reinsurance recoveries, adding 27% to the net loss ratio.

Catastrophe experience in the year was heavier than expectation and whilst no single loss would be considered market changing on its own, there was a marked increase in the frequency of events contributing 10.7% to the net claims ratio.
The Syndicate's biggest exposure to these was through hurricane Laura (net incurred claims of GBP 21.5m).
data.data_quality_notes: Gross opening claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet liabilities (Claims outstanding) - high confidence. A large RITC (assumption of 2017 years from Syndicates 5820 and 1206) distorts the gross claims development triangle and prevents a reliable gross prior-year development calculation from the triangle; the notes do not provide a gross 'movement in prior year's provision' figure. The only explicit quantified prior-year movement in the report is a net deterioration of GBP 7.9m disclosed in the net claims incurred commentary - this value has been used as a fallback (NET of reinsurance) and therefore the prior_year_development_gbp_m is NET, not GROSS. LOB-specific prior-year amounts are not quantified; LOB directions are inferred from narrative. Segmental gross premium mix taken from Note 7 segmental analysis (direct classes copied verbatim plus consolidated reinsurance inwards total).
